Write a detailed SOP for [describe the process — e.g., "onboarding a new client from signed contract to project kickoff" or "publishing a blog post" or "processing a refund request"].
In my business, this process currently involves: [describe the rough steps, tools used, people involved].
The SOP should include: (1) Purpose — why this process exists and when it's triggered, (2) Roles — who's responsible for each step ([just me / my VA / my team member]), (3) Step-by-step instructions — numbered, specific enough that someone who's never done it could follow along, (4) Tools & resources needed (with links/placeholders), (5) Quality checklist — what "done right" looks like, (6) Common mistakes to avoid, (7) FAQ — answers to questions that come up when following this process, (8) Version and last-updated date. Write it so I could hand this to a new hire on Day 1 and they could execute it without asking me 20 questions.
